overview: Island Tower is the newest Disney Vacation Club building at the Polynesian, a tower on the Seven Seas Lagoon with views toward Magic Kingdom.
suits: Families who want a modern villa with the Polynesian's location and amenities.
rooms: As a Disney Vacation Club resort, rooms range from studios with a kitchenette to multi-bedroom villas with a full kitchen and washer and dryer. You don't need to be a member to stay; you can book with cash like a regular hotel.
pools: Island Tower has its own pool, Cove Pool, with rows of lounge chairs and umbrellas in front of the tower and a splash area where a Moana figure rides a raft among the fountains. Guests can use the Polynesian's other pools too.
dining: Guests use the Polynesian's restaurants, including 'Ohana, Kona Cafe and Pineapple Lanai. At the foot of the tower there's also a covered bar looking out over the lagoon.
cons: A walk to the Polynesian's monorail station
tips: Request a Magic Kingdom-facing room for fireworks views.
Use the boat to Magic Kingdom for a relaxing ride.
bestFor: Families who want a modern villa at the Polynesian.
